description: Set or clear the workspace webhook URL for job-failure and dashboard status alerts (pass an empty url to clear). When events fire, tlly POSTs JSON to that URL (Slack and Discord incoming webhooks get a short text payload instead). Events include job_failed, status_changed (keep panel "id" fields in specs so alerts stay attached), and threshold_crossed. Email alerts work without a webhook. Caps: 12 emails and 60 webhooks per account per hour; the same panel is not alerted twice within an hour.

url.description: https URL, or empty to clear

name: set_alert_webhook
title: Set alert webhook URL
